change: Only final 5x5 separable convolution dilation changes from1 to2 relative to the fine-grid control. This restores a theoretical 47x47-input-pixel receptive field versus31x31 without adding weights. It does not recreate the coarse model or restore image detail lost during resizing.
supervision: Identical fine-grid pixels, targets, folds, background exclusions, objective and final-epoch selection. Verify saved targets byte-exact against both fine-grid controls.
training_gate: Relative to coarse controls, both seeds must improve decoded known blue target coverage on public FIT scenes, with no known red regression there or known red/blue regression on original FIT scenes. No development-based selection or threshold sweep.
runtime: Do not infer latency from equal parameter count. Dilation kernel support, conversion parity and actual Pi latency require separate measurement if the accuracy gate passes.
